header.title: Open Calculations Studio
header.desc: Open-source desktop app for structural calculations — inspired by CalcPAD, with direct export to IFC4x3 STEP and IFCX JSON-LD. Previously Ifc-Calc, rebuilt under the OpenAEC Foundation.

screenshot.caption: CalcPAD-syntax editor with live preview · wind-load calculation · parametric SVG drawing

what.title: What is Open Calculations Studio?
what.desc: Open Calculations Studio is a modern, open-source tool for structural calculations — inspired by CalcPAD, the widely-used tool among Dutch and European structural engineers. We rebuilt the entire calculation engine in TypeScript with support for CalcPAD syntax, and added live IFC and IFCX export so calculations integrate directly with BIM models.
what.list1: CalcPAD-compatible — existing .cpd files work without changes
what.list3: Live IFCX + IFC4x3 STEP export — a calculation becomes a BIM element straight away
what.list4: KaTeX rendering — mathematical formulas with real fractions, sub/superscripts and Greek letters
what.list5: SVG drawings — parametric diagrams directly inside the calculation
what.list6: Load cases — SLS / ULS / seismic in separate tabs
what.list7: Usable as a library — embed in FEM applications or code checks

why.title: Why Open Calculations Studio?
why.desc1: CalcPAD has been used for years by Dutch structural engineers for hand calculations. But it's closed-source, runs only on Windows, and has no built-in BIM integration. Open Calculations Studio brings CalcPAD functionality to modern web tech: cross-platform, open source, and with direct IFC export.
why.desc2: The 1094-line 2259-Intertek-units.cpd regression file evaluates with 0 errors and renders 6 SVG drawings. Enough for real-world project calculations.

units.title: Formulas with units
units.desc: Work with mm, kN, N/mm², mm⁴ and all SI units. Mathjs handles unit-aware arithmetic and automatic simplification (b*h → mm²).

katex.title: Math typesetting
katex.desc: KaTeX rendering with real fractions, superscripts, subscripts and Greek letters (σ, ε, ρ, Φ, ψ). Formulas show name = formula = filled-in values = result on one line.

editor.title: Live preview
editor.desc: Split-pane editor (CodeMirror 6) with syntax highlighting for .cpd. Debounced preview re-renders as you type.

loadcases.title: Load cases
loadcases.desc: Tabs for SLS / ULS / earthquake etc., each with its own prompt values for input variables. One document, multiple scenarios.

calcpad.title: CalcPAD-compatible
calcpad.desc: Fully compatible with existing .cpd files: #if/#else if/#end if, #repeat, #for, #def macros, #include, $Plot, matrices, lookups.

ifc.title: IFC4x3 STEP export
ifc.desc: Detects structural elements via conventional variable names (b_fdn, l_fdn, D_paal, M_Ed, R_c_d). Generates valid Project → Site → Building → Storey skeleton.

ifcx.title: IFCX JSON-LD
ifcx.desc: Live IFCX (draft) export — the next generation of IFC with namespaces for calculations, standards and metadata. Calculation and BIM model in one format.

svg.title: SVG drawings
svg.desc: Parametric SVG macros with value interpolation. @img(file.svg) embeds external drawings inline. @svg ... @end for hand-written SVG.

viewer.title: IFC tab
viewer.desc: Built-in STEP viewer and IFCX JSON viewer with syntax highlighting. Clickable entity types link directly to buildingSMART documentation.

gef.title: GEF upload
gef.desc: @gef name upload — use sounding data directly in foundation calculations. Integrates with Open Geotechniek Studio.

themes.title: 5 themes
themes.desc: Light, Forge, OpenAEC, Blueprint and Contrast — all built on OpenAEC design tokens. Pick what works best for your environment.

pdf.title: PDF export
pdf.desc: Print-ready PDF export via Tauri shell with headless preview. Ready for project file or third-party review.

library.title: Library mode
library.desc: Use @ifc-calc/core as a TypeScript library: parse, evaluate, render, generate IFC/IFCX from FEM apps or code-checking.

compat.title: CalcPAD compatibility
compat.desc: Fully subset compatible with real-world CalcPAD files. Works out-of-the-box on your existing .cpd documents:

structural.title: Structural engineers
structural.desc: Hand calculations for beams, columns, foundations — directly in a readable document. Open your existing CalcPAD files without migration.

bim.title: BIM modelers
bim.desc: Link calculations directly to IFC elements. No manual transfer of values — the check lives in the model.

education.title: Education & training
education.desc: Structural engineering students learn to calculate with real syntax they'll meet in practice. Open source — no license costs.

fem.title: FEM developers
fem.desc: Embed @ifc-calc/core in your own FEM application for pre/post-processing or code-checking. TypeScript library, npm-installable.

tech.title: Technology
tech.desc: Monorepo with three packages: @ifc-calc/core (parser + evaluator + IFC generator as a TypeScript library), @openaec/calculations-studio (Tauri 2 desktop app with React 19 UI), and @ifc-calc/web (browser-only build). Cross-platform: Windows, macOS, Linux.
